mode: read-only source audit; no runtime execution or hardware measurements
scope: Pinned TU117 normal boot/first GSP_INIT transaction, V3 overlay snapshot. Includes persistent owned buffers whose addresses are published by this path. No claim of full dynamic RPC callback closure.
finding: The original source has an explicit per-buffer consumption boundary for pExternalBindata: successful synchronous GSP_INIT response and successful static-info decode, then free while GSP remains live. Thus all-GPU-engines-stopped is not the original positive lifetime contract for this one copied root. This does not authenticate a receipt today, clear the session hardware-DMA lease, or prove other buffer retirement.

external_bindata.name: pKernelGsp->pExternalBindata
external_bindata.role: external ucodes binary copied for GSP initialization

construction.memdesc_kind: fresh owning root, ADDR_SYSMEM, NV_MEMORY_NONCONTIGUOUS, NV_MEMORY_CACHED, KERNEL_MODE; not a submem descriptor
construction.allocation_shape: One memdesc/backing allocation contains ALL radix levels and ALL copied ucodes data pages. No per-leaf memdesc, no per-leaf free.
construction.cpu_mapping: temporary memdescMap for table construction and data copy; memdescUnmap before kgspCreateRadix3 returns
construction.address_publication: GSP_ARGUMENTS_CACHED.bindataArgs.radix3 = root AT_GPU address; bindataArgs.size = logical ucodesBinSize. Intermediate PDE and leaf PTE entries are also AT_GPU addresses obtained from SAME root allocation.
construction.hardware_consumer: GSP RM/LibOS runtime consumes external bindata via radix3. Host C gives it to GSP arguments; it does not hand this root directly to CE/GR/FECS/other engine DMA registers. Firmware can redistribute/copied ucodes; absence of additional firmware DMA use cannot be established by this C audit.
construction.actual_alloc_rounding: memdescActualSize/OS allocator may round further, especially first huge-page request. Formula is requested radix allocation size, not actual peak or physical pages measured on hardware.

required_original_order: normal TU102 bootstrap has linked actual GSP status queue
allocate 48KB CPU static-info response staging buffer
gmcapiCommand executes GSP_INIT synchronously with encodedSystemInfo input
gpuSendGmcRpc assigns request sequence and copies input into CPU RPC staging
kgspSendRpc sends actual command queue; polling waits for matching command ID and sequence
gmcapiDispatch only returns NV_OK after successful transport and GMC response.status == NV_OK
_kgspDecodeGspStaticInfo must return NV_OK from both nvkvDecode and key handler context status
publish gspRmInitialized NV_TRUE and clear unloaded bit; heartbeat optional
ONLY THEN memdescFree(pExternalBindata), memdescDestroy(pExternalBindata), and NULL field
free CPU static-info staging buffer; return NV_OK
normal_consumption_contract.shutdown_before_positive_free: NONE: GSP remains running; IRQ/DMA session remains active. This is an original protocol consumption lifetime, not a hardware/session stop receipt.
normal_consumption_contract.evidence_strength: Original host source treats successful INIT response + successful decode as consuming copied bindata. The free and explicit destructor comment corroborate it. It is not a formal firmware-side no-future-read proof, a hardware trace, a signed acknowledgement, or a whole-device DMA stop.
normal_consumption_contract.response_flags_caveat: Expected GMC response path asserts RESPONSE flag rather than a checked rejection. A successor receipt must hard-check actual response class/flags as well as command and sequence; flags must not be inferred from NV_OK.

whole_release_graph.effect: On RefCount>1 with Allocated==1: only bDeferredFree=true and return. On not allocated or remaining Allocated count: returns without physical free. A receipt cannot assume physical release from the void return.

For UNIX/MODS non-ARM root, destroy EVERY root IOMMU mapping; each root destroys all child submappings, removes root from memdesc, calls osIovaUnmap, frees mapping metadata. Scope is full root, not just first radix page.
Handle any actual subdevice descriptors; selected fresh root construction does not itself create them. Full runtime identity/alias inventory is still required.
Uses ActualSize/pageArrayGranularity and osFreePagesInternal -> nv_free_pages(memdata) for ALL pages (tables + copied data + allocator rounding) of the owning root.
Removes descriptor ref; at zero releases metadata and remaining IOMMU state, may trigger deferred or previously omitted free. Additional ref/child state can delay destruction.
Original source clears member after void calls; safe port must not let metadata/destructor/nulling proceed when release is refused or incomplete.

failure_and_alternative_paths.result: No external root constructed/published. TU117 OS firmware fetch normally requires ucodes except GB10Y; do not silently use absent branch as target proof.
kgspCreateRadix3 returns failed status before bindataArgs publication; there may be partial root state only if create itself provided it. No consumed receipt.

failure_and_alternative_paths.path: huge page allocation fails with NO_MEMORY
failure_and_alternative_paths.result: Retries allocation of SAME root at regular page size; no second external root is returned. Other alloc failure reaches error cleanup.

failure_and_alternative_paths.path: allocation or CPU mapping fails in kgspCreateRadix3
failure_and_alternative_paths.result: error_ret calls memdescFree/destroy and nulls output BEFORE publication to GSP arguments on this first, fresh construction. This can use a proven never-exposed allocation path, not INIT-consumed receipt.
Already built external root remains in member for later lifecycle cleanup; actual entry phase must decide whether ever published. No consumption receipt.
NV_ERR_NO_MEMORY returns before INIT; external root remains. No INIT receipt.

failure_and_alternative_paths.path: GSP_INIT request send, poll timeout, cancellation, transport, response bounds, or response status fails
failure_and_alternative_paths.result: goto done frees only CPU static-info staging; external root remains, no consumption receipt. RPC may already have reached device, so not a never-exposed allocation.

failure_and_alternative_paths.path: successful INIT RPC but static-info decode/key handler fails
failure_and_alternative_paths.result: goto done frees CPU staging; external root remains. Follow original conservative lifetime: no consumption receipt even if firmware may already have consumed it.

failure_and_alternative_paths.path: INIT+decode succeeds but actual root release refused/incomplete
failure_and_alternative_paths.result: Current original free calls are void; proposed port must intercept before first free/destructor mutation and retain root identity/backing/IOVA if any release step cannot safely complete. Do not clear member, spend receipt twice, or treat NV_OK from outer function as physical retirement.

failure_and_alternative_paths.path: early bootstrap/health failure and final destruct
failure_and_alternative_paths.result: kgspFreeBootArgs_TU102 fallback frees root if still non-NULL, with explicit already-freed-after-INIT_DONE comment. The free helper itself performs no hardware stop. A failed or incomplete normal unload is not proof to permit this fallback.

Successor must forbid reuse/re-exposure of consumed root or stale bindataArgs address across a new generation. The original success path does not clear bindataArgs fields. A single-shot owner and exact publication ledger are required; no generic replay grant.

identity_and_alias_limits: All named direct member accesses are inventoried below; the selected fresh constructor never calls memdescCreateSubMem on this root. This is source evidence, not a dynamic whole-program pointer-alias proof.

One receipt covers exactly one root allocation generation/serial and all of its physical pages and mappings; it cannot be used for a different copied buffer, recycled address, child metadata, other device owner, or later boot attempt.
Selected original source has no kgspFreeRadix3_IMPL function. The actual release path is memdescFree+memdescDestroy on the root.

Root reference counts, subdevice descriptors, peer mappings, IOVA mapping generations, and any OS/backend resource rounding must be captured from actual ownership records, not inferred from member-pointer equality.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: WPR metadata pWprMetaV1Descriptor
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: Root SYSMEM AT_GPU PA in SEC2 Booter mailbox via _kgspGetBooterLoadArgs normal boot; includes all nested physical sources below.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: SEC2 Booter Load; source comments say Booter loads/verifies/boots into WPR2.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: Persistent through GSP lifetime; free in kgspFreeBootArgs_TU102 from kgspDestruct. No early consumption free in selected source.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: GSP firmware radix3 pGspUCodeRadix3Descriptor
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: WPR metadata.sysmemAddrOfRadix3Elf, sizeOfRadix3Elf; one root holds radix tables plus copied image.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: SEC2 Booter Load reads firmware and copies to WPR2. C radix helper comment broadly calls post-copy consumer GSP; do not turn it into exclusive hardware endpoint proof.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: Free only kgspFreeBootArgs_TU102 on final destructor, not after Booter success. No approved early receipt.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: GSP boot binary pGspRmBootUcodeMemdesc
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: WPR metadata.sysmemAddrOfBootloader plus monitor code/data/manifest offsets.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: SEC2 Booter Load reads/copies boot image into device WPR2.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: _kgspFreeBootBinaryImage from kgspDestruct; immediate fail cleanup occurs during host preparation before publication.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: Firmware signature pSignatureMemdesc
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: WPR metadata.sysmemAddrOfSignature and size; code requires Booter DMA 256-byte alignment.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: kgspFreeBootArgs_TU102 final destructor; no early success receipt in source.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: LibOS init-args pLibosInitArgumentsDescriptor
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: AT_GPU PA written GSP mailbox registers via kgspProgramLibosBootArgsAddr_TU102 before Booter starts RISC-V.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: GSP boot/runtime processor consumes LibOS memory-region table.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: RMARGS pGspArgumentsDescriptor
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: AT_GPU PA and size in LibOS init region id RMARGS; contains message queues, state monitor, bindata.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: kgspFreeBootArgsCommon final destructor; cached bindataArgs can remain stale after successful external free, therefore exact one-shot/re-exposure discipline required.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: Shared RPC queue pMQCollection->pSharedMemDesc
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: One root containing AT_GPU page table + command and status queues; GSP args.sharedMemPhysAddr points first page.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: GSP reads command ring and writes status ring/headers, CPU writes command and reads status; exact system-memory DMA actor beyond GSP cannot be independently proven from firmware here.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: _kgspFreeRpcInfrastructure->GspMsgQueuesCleanup final destructor; CPU staging pWorkArea/pRpc are separate CPU objects.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: LibOS logs LOGINIT and LOGRM
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: Two LibOS2 task buffers; per-buffer AT_GPU PA in second word and LibOS init-region list. TU117 count=2, no LibOS3 INTR/MNOC/DEBUG/ROOT/RMON buffers and no kernel log.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: GSP INIT/RM tasks write log SYSMEM; CPU log decoder reads.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: _kgspFreeLibosLoggingStructures stops log polling, dumps, deregisters flush callback, destroys decoder then unmaps/frees both buffers. This does not itself stop GSP writer; relies outer normal shutdown.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: RM state monitor pRmStateMonitorBufferMD
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: Optional successful 4KB shared allocation; AT_GPU PA/size in rmStateMonitorBufferArgs. Allocation failure is checked non-fatally by kgspInitRm; arguments zero unless both pointer and descriptor exist.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: GSP state-monitor service writes shared buffer.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: Notify-operation pNotifyOpSurfMemDesc
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: Unconditional GSP constructor allocation; AT_GPU PA serialized in system-info field NOTIFY_OP_SHARED_SURF_PHYS_ADDR and delivered by GSP_INIT.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: GSP completion/status writes per structure comments; TU117 notify dispatch may refuse operations, but that does not erase actual address publication.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: External ucodes pExternalBindata
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: One root radix3 copied from ucodes_tu10x.bin and published via GSP args.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: Successful synchronous GSP_INIT + decode frees entire root while GSP/IRQ remains active. Failure retains for final destructor.

normal_boot_dma_families.name: FWSEC code/data (VBIOS dependent)
normal_boot_dma_families.exposure: TU102 executor accepts WITH_LOADER or DIRECT. WITH_LOADER publishes pCodeMemDesc/pDataMemDesc AT_GPU bases in Falcon DMEM loader descriptor ctxDma=PHYS_SYS_NCOH; DIRECT CPU-copies image into IMEM/DMEM.
normal_boot_dma_families.hardware_consumer: GSP Falcon running FWSEC/FRTS/SB loader consumes sysmem code/data if WITH_LOADER; direct pImage itself is CPU PIO staging.
normal_boot_dma_families.lifetime: kgspFreeFlcnUcode final destructor (or allocation failure before execution). Same FWSEC object may be reused for shutdown SB, so first successful FRTS does not justify early free.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: CrashCat host queue
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: Not allocated by TU102 kgspConfigureFalcon: zeroed config leaves allocQueueSize=0. Generic WPR metadata branch publishes queue only if descriptor exists.
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.limit: Different constructor/configuration or new allocation would add runtime DMA backing; do not assume globally absent.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: Profiler samples
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: pProfilerSamples and pProfilerSamplesMD both non-NULL; selected full source only contains reads in kgspPopulateGspRmInitArgs, no non-generated writer/allocation found.
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.limit: Do not turn absence of named writes into whole-program alias proof.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: SYSMEM heap
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: Only bGpuArchIsZeroFb; TU117 has physical FB, current target should choose zero PA/size branch.
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.limit: Requires actual frozen device facts to admit; not a guessed target flag.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: Simulation access buffer
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: Only IS_SIMULATION allocation and address publication; physical Lenovo excludes if actual platform facts prove bare metal.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: RATS crash shared buffer
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: Compile feature plus runtime enable; allocated and published by RPC only AFTER GSP_INIT/bootstrap success.
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.limit: Not part of first INIT transaction; later kgspInitRm still can expose new backing. Default/compile gate was not promoted by this audit.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: Suspend/resume radix3 + metadata
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: Prepared only PM/suspend/resume path; normal boot _kgspGetBooterLoadArgs selects WPR metadata.
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.limit: Not silently authorized by first-transaction receipt; must keep separate generation/operation proof.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: Booter load/unload image pImage
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: TU102 DIRECT ucode path is CPU PIO staging, no host source PA passed; newer BOOT_FROM_HS memdesc path is not accepted by TU102 executor.
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.limit: SEC2 Booter itself subsequently DMA-reads metadata/image sources. PIO image staging observation does not stop those DMAs.

conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.name: Encoded system info, registry table, static-info response, firmware handles/log ELF/build ID
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.condition: CPU staging/storage is copied into queue or used by decoder; those host pointer addresses are not passed as DMA backing directly in selected code.
conditional_and_cpu_only_exclusions.limit: Encoded bytes contain other device addresses (notify surface and hardware BARs), and registry/system info serialized values can configure firmware. Do not classify all payload data as inert.

candidate_consumption_receipt.status: DESIGN ONLY; implementation pending; no issuer, production default, admission bit, verifier, or hardware gate changed
candidate_consumption_receipt.name: one-root GSP_INIT bindata-consumed capability
candidate_consumption_receipt.semantics: Authorized internal evidence that this exact external-bindata root has passed the original semantic consumption boundary. Permits retiring ONLY this root (all tables/data/actual OS pages and owned IOVA mappings) while session IRQ/GSP stay active. It is NOT SessionHardwareDmaStop, GPU engine halt, completed GSP unload, proof of source text unload, or generic allocation retirement.
candidate_consumption_receipt.authentication_meaning: Kernel-owned unforgeable capability tied to actual owner/record and real function execution; no caller boolean/token derived from RPC NV_OK alone. This is not cryptographic firmware attestation.
bind_fields: frozen source/profile digest and exact original hook-site identity
owner identity and one-shot first-transaction generation
nv_state and actual OBJGPU/KernelGsp object identities (validated before dereference)
external-root memdesc identity plus monotonic allocation serial, backend resource identity, actual byte/page bounds
exact AT_GPU publication root address plus immutable ordered page-address/mapping-generation digest for all table/data/rounded backing
unique command 0x00010001 request sequence, boot attempt epoch and actual response class/RESPONSE flag
transport completion and firmware response.status==NV_OK AND successful bounded static-info decode/key-handler status
no prior sticky refusal/cancellation, no re-exposure/new boot, no outstanding CPU borrowers or conflicting release permits
single-use retirement phase and actual backend unmap/free completion; distinguish physical freed vs metadata completion
proposed_state_machine: Published only after source-bound args publication on this owner generation
InitRequestInFlight bound to actual request sequence
Consumed observed only after actual synchronous successful INIT and successful decode, immediately BEFORE original first memdescFree mutation
one scoped retire permit reserved before free; sticky refusal after issue does not permit unrelated frees
retirement complete only after every owned IOVA/backend page release confirms completion, then metadata/nulling commit
any invalidation, stale identity, mutation, replay, failure, partial completion or unknown alias -> retain/quarantine remaining ownership; never global hardware-DMA hold clear
necessary_open_work: Prove exact source hook / compiled body and immutable root-to-backend mapping; no guessed memdesc layout or synthetic artifact-only receipt.
Hard-check response type/flags at real matched response path; original assertion alone cannot authenticate a release capability.
Prove ordering and queue response stability under real GPU locks/ordinary worker; bind release after successful decoder result, not callback completion guessed from outer NV_OK.
No direct release admission if record is submem, multi-owner, has unknown child/peer IOVA, live aliases/borrows, changed page list, previously retired, or identity reuse.
Retain memdesc/KernelGsp member before any void destructive call if scoped permission cannot be obtained; propagate release failures without clearing owner field.

Original argument page retains old bindataArgs address after free. Prove no later access/republication (single-shot contract) or implement reviewed invalidation, without treating zeroed host bytes as device DMA fence.

Firmware-side consumer semantics are only represented by the original host free contract; decide explicit acceptance of pinned signed firmware protocol, not generic NV_OK. No firmware disassembly performed.

Exercise negative controls: wrong owner/gen/serial/sequence/response flags, send failure, timeout/cancel, response error, decode failure, address alias/reuse, partial unmap/free, repeated retirement and boot re-entry.
Run authoritative native and target-specific checks before changing AllocationRetirementUnderActiveIrq. Whole gate still needs all other actual allocations and PM/IRQ producer/stack closure.

normal_shutdown_scope: Persistent queue/log/args/boot sources are freed by object destruction after the normal completed outer unload path. Source helper calls themselves do not query hardware halt. Existing read-only stop audit covers suspend mailbox + FWSEC SB + SEC2 Booter unload/WPR2 checks; those are not repeated here and do not independently prove all-engine DMA cessation.
limits: No actual hardware addresses/IOVA, DMA transactions or engine halt states measured. No fixed full allocation count/peak asserted.
Expected hardware consumers are source-bound address publication endpoints, not exclusive firmware-engine ownership proofs. Proprietary GSP can initiate additional operations.
GSP poll processes asynchronous RPC/GMC events before matching INIT response; dynamic requests may expose additional backing. This is not full incoming-event/root closure.
The selected C source has neither _kgspGetGspRmBootParams nor kgspFreeRadix3_IMPL. Actual interfaces are kgspPopulateGspRmInitArgs/LibOS args/WPR metadata and root memdesc free.
Source call success is not physical backend release success; void free/destructor paths need a source-bound checked integration.

No production source, existing frozen executable package, hardware stop verifier, production admission default or issuer was modified by this source audit. This package persists design and evidence only.
